generatedOutput.requirementSummary: When a user selects a Condenser Type and Refrigerant, the Unit Type dropdown must be populated filtered by the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant. After a Unit Type is selected (with Refrigerant already chosen), the Unit Size dropdown must be populated filtered by the selected Refrigerant and Unit Type.
businessRules: If a user selects a Condenser Type and a Refrigerant, the system must populate the Unit Type dropdown with entries from SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant filtered by the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant (the exact filtering mechanism is not defined in the ticket).

If a user selects a Unit Type (after selecting a Refrigerant), the system must populate the Unit Size dropdown with entries from SDCommonUnitModelSizes filtered by the selected Refrigerant and Unit Type.
The dropdown data is retrieved via a GET request to /dropdowns on the unitdesign API.
developerConsiderations: Call the unitdesign API GET /dropdowns to obtain SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant and SDCommonUnitModelSizes data.
For Unit Type filtering, apply the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant to the SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant dataset (filtering logic to be defined based on the data model).
For Unit Size filtering, apply the selected Refrigerant and Unit Type to the SDCommonUnitModelSizes dataset using the parent array.
Update the Unit Type and Unit Size dropdowns dynamically in the UI when the relevant selections change.
